Ternary Plots

Source: vignettes/articles/r-docs/ternary-plots.Rmd
ternary-plots.Rmd

Basic Ternary Plot with Markers 

library(plotly.core)

journalist <- c(75, 70, 75, 5, 10, 10, 20, 10, 15, 10, 20)
developer <- c(25, 10, 20, 60, 80, 90, 70, 20, 5, 10, 10)
designer <- c(0, 20, 5, 35, 10, 0, 10, 70, 80, 80, 70)
label <- c("point 1", "point 2", "point 3", "point 4", "point 5", "point 6",
           "point 7", "point 8", "point 9", "point 10", "point 11")


df <- data.frame(journalist, developer, designer, label)

# axis layout
axis <- function(title) {
  go_ternary_axis(
    title = go_ternary_axis_title(text = title, font = go_font(size = 20)),
    tickfont = go_font(size = 15),
    tickcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    ticklen = 5
  )
}


fig <- df |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatterternary(
    mode = "markers",
    a = ~journalist,
    b = ~developer,
    c = ~designer,
    text = ~label,
    marker = go_scatterternary_marker(
      symbol = 100,
      color = "#DB7365",
      size = 14,
      line = go_scatterternary_marker_line(width = 2)
    )
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    title = "Simple Ternary Plot with Markers",
    ternary = go_ternary(
      sum = 100,
      aaxis = axis("Journalist"),
      baxis = axis("Developer"),
      caxis = axis("Designer")
    )
  )

fig

#Reference

See go_scatterternary() for more information and options!
